notes: Same access route as Bestsellers (direct HTTP fetch, SSR __NEXT_DATA__ decode, no block). Checked all 436 unique nav node names across header/footer/mobile nav - no Clearance, Clearances, Clearance Sale, Outlet, Final Sale, Final Clearance, Last Chance, or End of Line node exists anywhere. Checked sitemap_categories.xml - no clearance/outlet-named category URL. Checked the site's own 'Promotions' facet (allPromotions.en) on a live category page (household-decor): its only value across the catalog is 'Sale' (e.g. 402 decor products tagged Sale) - there is no 'Clearance' or 'Outlet' facet value anywhere in the taxonomy. Found one homepage banner ('HDB_HP-_01_-25-70% off-Online&Instore') linking to /s/sale-offers; opened it - it is a static CMS landing page (staticPageReducer, no own product-listing block/nbHits, i.e. not itself a PLP) titled around a '25-70% off Online & Instore' percent-off campaign, linking out to 16 category pages all filtered by the generic q=allPromotions.en:Sale parameter (not Clearance-worded) plus a few generic price-band /search links and a 'Best Price' badge search - no clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line wording appears anywhere in its copy or in the linked category taxonomy. Per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test this is a textbook generic temporary promotional Sale campaign (percent-off, no permanence signal, site's own taxonomy calls it 'Sale' not 'Clearance/Outlet'), so it is excluded, not recorded as ambiguous. As a supporting check, internal site search for 'clearance' returned nbHits=16896, essentially the whole catalog - a non-discriminating fallback result, not evidence of a real Clearance section. Concluding no genuine Clearance-taxonomy PLP exists on this storefront; only a generic, correctly-excluded Sale promotion.
